text:
Ethan (AE): Heads-up — Hydrus procurement paused until we deliver a clean MSA/DPA + order form. They also want split invoicing: US entity (USD) and UK entity (GBP). cc @Priyanka @Jules :wave

Marta (SE): Any technical asks in their redline?

Ethan (AE): They attached a redline PDF and called out three items: HSM/BYOK wording, an SLA credit schedule (they proposed 20% credit >0.2% downtime), and acceptance of their SignFlow e-sign tool instead of DocuSign. Link: https://files.example/hydrus/redline.pdf

Priyanka (Legal): I'll triage the redlines. 20% credits is way beyond standard — we'll propose capped credits and mutuality language. On BYOK/HSM we need exact operational guarantees. 

Jules (Finance): For split invoicing we need both VAT numbers and billing addresses. Also confirm whether they want consolidated reporting or separate invoices per PO. Currency conversion: we can invoice GBP but need FX clause. Net30 is standard; they requested net45 for UK entity.

Marta (SE): Technical note: Dedicated EU deployment required. We support customer KMS via our HSM gateway (PKCS#11), but BYOK import has a documented process and key rotation responsibilities (customer). I'll paste the short blurb to include in appendix: "Customer remains sole holder of key material; Redwood operates HSM gateway for wrapping/unwrapping as instructed; access to key metadata is logged."

Priyanka (Legal): Good. I'll draft a KMS appendix that references the HSM integration doc and specifies audit log retention (1 year default, can extend by agreement). For SLA credits, propose: "Service credits capped at up to 5% of monthly fee per incident window and aggregate cap of 15% per year."

Ethan (AE): Hydrus insists on SignFlow. Is that a blocker?

esign-bot: SignFlow is a third-party e-sign tool. Requirements: sample audit log, signer identity proof, and signed consent to e-sign via third-party. Legal review required. See: https://internal.redwood/esign-thirdparty

Jules (Finance): Accounting can accept SignFlow-signed PDFs if audit trail satisfies our policy. We'll need the PO number on the signed order. Also confirm billing split in the order form lines: line 1 USD to Hydrus, Inc. (US), line 2 GBP to Hydrus UK Ltd.

Priyanka (Legal): Action plan: I'll produce a clean MSA+DPA bundle with KMS appendix, capped SLA credit language, and an e-sign acceptance clause that allows SignFlow if audit log attached. ETA end of day GMT.

Marta (SE): I'll attach the Dedicated deployment checklist and BYOK steps so their infra can start parallel work. Also: Hydrus asked for 120-day model-pinning for their initial prod migration — that's longer than usual. Can Legal enumerate constraints?

Priyanka (Legal): I'll add conditional model-pinning language: "Customer may request a model pin for up to 120 days subject to compatibility and security review; Redwood reserves the right to unpin for security or performance reasons with 30 days notice."

Ethan (AE): Summary / next steps:
- Priyanka: Clean MSA+DPA+KMS appendix + e-sign clause by EOD
- Marta: Deployment checklist + BYOK steps + confirmation on model-pinning feasibility
- Jules: Template for split invoicing (USD/GBP), FX clause, confirm net45 exception for UK AR
- Ethan: Ask Hydrus procurement for both VAT IDs, billing addresses, and SignFlow sample audit log

Jules (Finance): I'll prep the billing lines and confirm if AR will accept net45 for the UK leg; will report back in thread.

Ethan (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll request the VAT IDs and the SignFlow sample log from Hydrus now. :thumbsup:

esign-bot: Reminder checklist posted: https://internal.redwood/esign-thirdparty/checklist — include audit log and signer authority doc when returning the signed file.

Priyanka (Legal): Will upload clean docs to this thread once ready.

Ethan (AE): Closing loop — will update when procurement replies. :white_check_mark:
